theme_archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) mixed with Editorial Warmth
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement these design guidelines exactly as specified. Ensure all interactive elements include the specified data-testid attributes. Focus on making the editorial layout feel brighter, more modern, and visually lively by relying on crisp contrast, large typography, photography insertions, and subtle CSS motion.

color_palette.primary_description: SWU Brand Blue. Use for primary CTAs, active states, and high-impact visual accents.
color_palette.secondary_description: SWU Brand Red. Use sparingly for notifications, badges, and contrasting visual highlights.
color_palette.neutral_description: Brand Gray. Use for secondary text, metadata, and subtle borders.
color_palette.background_main_description: Crisp White. Replaces the ubiquitous paper background in high-focus areas to increase brightness and modern feel.
color_palette.background_alt_description: Paper Tone. Retained from the original design but used strategically for section backgrounds, sidebars, and card fills to create warmth.
color_palette.text_primary_description: Ink Black. Used for all primary typography to maintain high-contrast legibility.

headlines.usage: H1, H2, and large pull quotes. Emphasizes the scholarly/editorial trust signal.

body_ui.usage: Body copy, UI elements, buttons, eyebrows (uppercase, tracking-widest).

visual_liveliness_strategy.color_temperature: Shift from an all-paper (#F7F4EE) baseline to a crisp white (#FFFFFF) baseline. Use paper (#F7F4EE) for offset bento cards and alternate sections to create visual rhythm.
visual_liveliness_strategy.imagery_integration: Inject photography directly into the grid. Use high-contrast, well-lit modern photography to break up dense text. Images should feel integrated, not like stock placeholders.
visual_liveliness_strategy.typography_moments: Use oversized, editorial-style typography for section transitions instead of thin hairlines. A massive H2 or a bold pull quote acts as a visual anchor.
visual_liveliness_strategy.modern_indicators: Subtle glassmorphism on sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80). Bento grids with 1px border (#1A1A1A/10) and rounded-2xl to soften rigid Swiss layouts.

hero_portrait.description: Woman wearing blue sweater. Use inside a bento grid cell on the homepage hero to add a human, vibrant element.

data_abstract.description: Abstract colorful data screen. Use as a background for the 'Showcase' or 'Tools' section to inject color.

knowledge_hub.description: Person holding a book. Use as the banner image for the /learn knowledge hub.

about_hero.description: Group of students walking. Use as the hero image for /about/swu-marketing, treated with a subtle blue duotone or placed within a crisp border.

homepage.layout_strategy: Start with a 12-column Bento Grid hero. Cell 1 (span-8): Massive typography ('SWU Marketing Research Platform') with a dynamic 'network of dots' CSS background. Cell 2 (span-4, tall): The 'hero_portrait' image, full bleed. Below the fold, alternate between white and paper backgrounds. Tools bento should use 1px stroke borders on crisp white, hovering to reveal blue accents.

showcase.layout_strategy: Editorial gallery view. Instead of standard lists, use asymmetric masonry or a 3-column bento grid. Cards should have a pure white background, 1px border-ink/10, and a slight shadow on hover. Inject the 'data_abstract' image as a hero banner spanning the top.

learn_index.layout_strategy: Magazine index layout. The top featured article takes up 50% of the viewport height with the 'knowledge_hub' image on the left and a large serif headline on the right. Subsequent articles are presented in a clean 2-column list with generous padding (p-8).

learn_article.layout_strategy: Scholarly reading experience. Max-w-3xl for the main text column. Center the content but left-align the text. The background is pure white. Use the paper tone (#F7F4EE) for pull quotes and sidebar data tables to break the monotony. Use a large, bold Serif font for the title, followed by metadata (author, date) in neutral gray.

about.layout_strategy: Pillar page. Large 'about_hero' image spanning the top with a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-white to-transparent) fading into the text. Use the 'Swiss' layout: a 4-column grid where the left column (1 col) is sticky navigation/eyebrows, and the right (3 cols) is the main content.

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#1A1A1A]/10 transition-all duration-300

bento_card.style: bg-white border border-[#1A1A1A]/10 rounded-2xl p-8 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-all duration-300 ease-out flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-hidden relative

button_primary.style: bg-[#3597E4] text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-full font-sans font-medium hover:bg-[#2b7cbd] transition-colors duration-200 inline-flex items-center gap-2

section_transition.style: w-full py-24 sm:py-32 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center px-4

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All cards and buttons must have a clear hover state. Cards lift by 4px (-translate-y-1) and gain a soft shadow. Buttons slightly darken.
motion_and_interactions.entry_animations: On page load, use staggered CSS fade-up animations for the hero bento grid. Use simple keyframes: @keyframes fadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }.
motion_and_interactions.no_parallax: Strictly CSS transitions. No scroll-jacking or heavy javascript-based scroll animations to preserve Core Web Vitals.
